questions.question: How should we handle letta-mobile-ql563 given that the plugin host driver (s416w.28) isn't shipped yet?

options.label: A: Gate behind s416w.34
options.description: Demote ql563 to a downstream child of s416w.34 (reference plugin). Wait for s416w.28 (drivers) to land, then build link-card as a SECOND reference plugin demonstrating net:connect + putAsset + OG fetch. Status stays open; add 'gated-on-s416w.28' label.

options.label: B: Split into thin + fat
options.description: Split ql563 into a thin 'design + OG algorithm + manifest schema' bead (in scope today, no driver needed — purely sharedLogic + test fixture) and a thin 'wire-up + ship' bead (blocked on s416w.28). Lets you start on the design now.

options.label: C: Fold into s416w.34
options.description: Replace ql563's standalone plugin plan by making the s416w.34 reference plugin BE the link-card plugin. Drop ql563, add the link-card requirement to s416w.34's body.

options.label: D: Keep ql563 as-is, ignore gap
options.description: Leave ql563 in its current form. Acknowledge it can't ship until s416w.28 lands but proceed with planning/writing the manifest in advance.
